mechanism.name: Script-Proved Broad-Domain Door Component Field
mechanism.description: Frozen same-frame SCIL proves the requested public entity, while a generic ADE20K scene parser independently supplies raw door or screen-door connected components. Only the conjunction can attach entity authority to a Top-3 component.
mechanism.single_structural_change: Relative to failed PB6, replace the synthetic public-door classifier and hand-crafted geometry proposer with raw broad-domain ADE20K door-component regions. Identity cannot create a door component and door semantics cannot name an entity.
mechanism.information_source_change: The new information is a generic indoor/outdoor scene-semantic field with explicit door classes; no PB6 matcher threshold, seed, backbone comparison, crop, tracker, morphology, or fusion sweep is used.

scil.authority: PB4 Development-selected SCIL thresholds copied exactly and applied to the eight frozen candidate profiles as one pack.
scil.proof_rule: The highest entity score must meet both thresholds with no cross-carrier conflict. Only an exact proof for the source entity can carry its authority token; UNKNOWN and wrong proofs authorize nothing.

door_field.authority: PB7 Development selected this raw component-area threshold once on the consumed PB6 cohort, retaining a truth-member Top-3 component on three of four positives with zero presence on both no-portal negatives.
door_field.component_rule: Union door and screen-door ADE20K pixels, form raw eight-connected components, rank by semantic pixel area, and retain the first three meeting the frozen normalized-area and bottom priors.
door_field.truth_membership: A component box is a portal-set member when its center lies inside the frozen human region and at least half of its own area lies inside that region.
door_field.forbidden_processing: No morphology, crop, TTA, class sweep, model-size comparison, geometry proposer, OCR input, target identity, or ensemble.

cohort.wrong_request_proxy: Every frame is cross-paired with the other seven frozen entity requests. A typed authority token can name only the SCIL-proved entity.
cohort.freshness: No PB7 OCR or ADE20K semantic output was observed before exact files, aliases, roles, local sizes, hashes, and human portal regions were frozen.

metrics: SCIL correct proof, wrong proof, and UNKNOWN counts
raw door-component presence on positives, no-portal negatives, and OOD
joined Top-3 truth retention on four door-level positives
no-portal false authorization and open-entrance OOD authorization leakage
wrong-request authorization reduction versus unbound component attachment
balanced accuracy over four positives and four controls
forbidden COMMIT or navigation state leakage
stop_rule: Run exactly once. Do not change source files, aliases, human roles or boxes, SCIL thresholds, semantic model, classes, component rule, threshold, join, or gate after output. A failure closes this representation on the frozen cohort rather than triggering a rescue sweep.
next_step: If the gate passes, retain SCIL + BD-DCF as current-frame entity-bound portal-region proposal authority and test one frozen active-view action against a no-action control. If it fails, change the information modality rather than tune this cohort.
claim_boundary: Fresh entity-disjoint public-image confirmation of conditional same-frame entity proof plus coarse broad-domain door-component proposal authority. Door-component boxes may cover a portal region rather than precise door leaves. A pass would not establish natural prevalence, physical portal ownership, public access, opening state, traversability, active-view causality, temporal persistence, directional guidance, arrival, product benefit, user benefit, or safety.
